profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at CarGurus
profile.summary:
My name is Sohy and I'm a software engineer at CarGurus where our mission is to build the world's most trusted and transparent automotive marketplace 🚗

I love collaborating with teams to solve complex software development problems, and have passion for learning new technology! 🌟

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Building backend microservices and APIs for the CarGurus mobile app
• Java, Spring, SQL, APIs, microservices, databases, backend services

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
• Built data streaming system to reduce data processing time and enhanced performance & scalability of existing extract, transform, load (ETL) pipeline
• Java, Kafka, Spring

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Improved classification engine performance by 20%, increased neural net training dataset size by 20x, and reduced uncategorized data by 17% for better data categorization
• Python, MongoDB

honors.title: 2019 Grace Hopper Celebration of Women in Computing Scholarship
honors.issuer: Issued by Boston University Computer Science Department · Jul 2019

honors.title: Rewriting the Code Fellow
honors.issuer: Issued by Rewriting the Code · Jul 2018
